title: Art of War
description: If you do not play any Attacks during your turn, gain 1 additional Energy next turn.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic tracks whether any Attack cards are played during your turn. Energy is granted at the start of your next turn only if you didn't play any Attacks during your previous turn. The relic's active status changes based on game state and combat progression.
